instruction: Write a complete, verifier-safe XDP program for semantic family `nrf_fib_nexthop_router`. Inspect incoming traffic matching target criteria (Port 3128, Subnet 198.51.106.0/24, or Protocol specific tags). Apply specified filtering, routing, telemetry, or transformation action. Pass all non-matching and truncated packets safely with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Parse Ethernet and network layer headers
Validate packet boundaries and handle protocol fields safely
Maintain verifier safety with proper bounds and null checks
Return valid XDP action (XDP_PASS, XDP_DROP, XDP_TX, or XDP_REDIRECT)
Entry point SEC("xdp") and GPL license

tests.name: match_primary_rule
tests.description: Target rule on port 3128 must return XDP_TX

tests.name: truncated_packet_pass
tests.description: Truncated packet must return XDP_PASS safely
